script_text: Taurus, your Venus-ruled Earth sign gets money signals, not pep talks. Thursday through Saturday, Mars conjunct Neptune in your 12th House warns against guessing in love or signing what you cannot verify, while Venus trine Saturn from 3rd to 11th House steadies a partner. Friday hurts because Mars squares Jupiter, inflating costs and frustration. Monday, Venus enters Leo in your 4th House while the New Moon in Gemini lands in your 2nd House, trining Saturn in the 11th, so a budget, raise, or conversation can become official. Tuesday and Wednesday, the Sun sextiles Uranus in 1st House, opening a career/money door through networking. Wednesday is your power day because Venus in the 4th steadies your base and the 2nd House New Moon supports income. Worst day: Friday, because Mars square Jupiter tempts impulsive spending. Advice: write numbers down before saying yes. Follow for daily updates.

title: Taurus Money Shift Is Coming
youtube_description: Taurus, this week starts with Venus trine Saturn, which can steady love, then the Gemini New Moon in your 2nd House pushes a money decision into the open. The tricky part is Friday's Mars square Jupiter, which can tempt overpromising or overspending before the Sun sextile Uranus opens a career door. Comment your sign.
